title: Maximal Infinitesimal Variation of Hodge Structure for Singular Curves
summary: We study the infinitesimal variation of Hodge structure for families of algebraic curves and extend the classical theory from smooth curves to singular and non--planar settings. Using the deformation space $\mathrm{Ext}^1(Ω_X,\mathcal O_X)$ and the dualizing sheaf, we define a singular analogue of maximal infinitesimal variation. For equisingular families of plane curves with planar Gorenstein singularities, we prove that the infinitesimal variation attains maximal rank equal to the arithmetic genus.
